items.title: Sherrie Maricle interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 4, 2020 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: the camp director, a guy named Jeff Antoniuk, now he’s got Peter Erskine I think, Bob Mintzer

ctx.x: Yeah. Well you see, like I’m amazed by my friends and bandmates and other friends and some are like so, so positive. Like within one day, like my last job was March 10. I was in Cedar Rapids, Iowa at Coe College. I was on a little solo tour, like I was in Nebraska at the Nebraska Band Master’s Association. And I spent four days in Iowa and I went from, actually my trio was in Florida with Maurice Hines just before that. It was going great. I get home and then all you see, all your gigs like cancel, and it’s…

Like they’re not letting anything — they’re just so — and I’m sure like age is probably irrelevant but I’ve seen this from my younger bandmates especially. One is still in their twenties, they’re like, “This isn’t stopping me. Here’s my concert series.” Now they’re lucky if they live with like if you’re a bass player that lives with a pianist you’re cool, or any horn player that lives with a piano player or bass player. But if you’re a drummer and you live by…

Yeah. I’m actually negotiating with a fellow in France who admires our project here and he says would you let me try to do some interviews with French musicians, and he’ll send them to me, etcetera. So there are things that are happening that may not have happened.
